description: This file defines a core interface for connection monitoring within the Eclipse Ditto framework, encapsulating metrics and logging functionalities, along with default methods for success, failure, exception handling, and execution wrapping related to messaging and connection events.

classes.name: ConnectionMonitor
classes.description: An abstraction for connection monitoring that currently encapsulates metrics and logging into one interface, providing methods for reporting success, failures, exceptions, and wrapping execution with monitoring.

classes.name: ConnectionMonitor.WrappedConnectionMonitor
classes.description: An interface for wrapping execution of code blocks with monitoring for success, failure, or exception outcomes.

classes.name: ConnectionMonitor.Builder
classes.description: A builder interface for creating instances of ConnectionMonitor.

classes.name: ConnectionMonitor.InfoProvider
classes.description: An internal interface used for providing additional contextual information during monitoring events, such as correlation ID, timestamp, related thing ID, headers, and payload.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns the logger used by the monitor.

methods.name: getCounter
methods.description: Returns the counter used by the monitor.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Records a successful processing event, with various overloads accepting signals, messages, info providers, and custom messages.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Records a failure event, with overloads for signals, messages, headers, and exception details.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Records an exception occurrence, with overloads for signals, messages, headers, and custom messages.

methods.name: wrapExecution
methods.description: Wraps the execution of code blocks with automatic monitoring of success or failure, supporting both suppliers and runnables.
